purpose: Defines the head-to-head between the subagent arm (baseline, executed in desktop) and the agent-team arm (executed by the operator in the Terminal TUI). Both arms run the SAME two disjoint lanes (Lane A=WO-127 planning slice, Lane B=WO-128 planning slice) with the SAME lane packets and the SAME return-packet shape, so the five go/no-go criteria compare like-for-like.

teams.mechanism: Claude Code experimental agent teams (2 named teammates, shared task list, WO-117 team-governance hooks)

criteria.target: TeammateIdle / missing-return detection recorded within 5 minutes p95 and 10 minutes max
criteria.subagents_result: N/A — the Agent tool returns synchronously; there is no idle-teammate concept and no TeammateIdle hook in the subagent arm. This criterion is structurally unmeasurable without the Terminal team arm.
criteria.decides: Only the team arm can satisfy or fail this criterion. This is the single criterion that justifies running the Terminal arm at all.

criteria.target: at least one material issue caught before merge/closeout, or every lane records clean pre-merge evidence
criteria.subagents_result: PASS — 5 defects caught pre-merge (1 major: D-A1).

criteria.target: lead coordination time no more than 80 percent of sequential baseline
criteria.subagents_result: PASS — ~60 percent of sequential baseline (1 dispatch, 0 mid-flight interventions, parallel wall-clock saving 40.6 percent).
criteria.note: Team-arm labor may be HIGHER than the subagent baseline due to known v2.1.177 team limitations; the comparison must surface this honestly.

criteria.target: zero unauthorized path writes and zero missing-WO task closures
criteria.subagents_result: PASS — git-verified zero out-of-scope writes; both tasks cited WO references at create and close.

criteria.target: cost captured and reviewed; no default adoption if team cost exceeds subagent baseline by more than 25 percent without a justified quality win

decision_logic.this_session_reason: Real agent teams could not run in the executing desktop surface. The subagent baseline executed cleanly and is the architecturally correct path for a desktop-first operator.
decision_logic.path_to_partial_unlock_candidate: If the operator runs the Terminal team arm and it (a) records stall detection within the 5-min p95 / 10-min max window, (b) catches >=1 pre-merge defect or shows clean pre-merge evidence per lane, (c) keeps coordinator labor <=80 percent of sequential, (d) shows zero unauthorized writes and zero missing-WO closures, and (e) costs no more than 25 percent over the subagent baseline without a quality win — THEN WO-126 may be re-scored PARTIAL_UNLOCK_CANDIDATE. Teams remain non-default regardless.
decision_logic.path_to_no_go: If the team arm fails stall detection, writes out of scope, closes a task with no WO reference, or costs materially more without a quality win, the verdict stays at NO_GO for default adoption (subagents remain the path).
